channel.title: Common Sense Gay: The Daily Take

item.title: Texas isn't flipping because of primary voter math
item.description: The hottest take on X this week says Democratic primary voters are swamping the Texas early vote. Here's why counting primary voters tells you a lot less than it looks like, and what the better model says.

item.title: Texas, early voting is open. Here's where to go.
item.description: Early voting in Texas opened this morning and runs through Friday, October 30. Here's what's on the ballot, what to bring, and how to find the closest place to vote in about 30 seconds.

item.title: Four days in a row, and Texas votes tomorrow
item.description: The Democratic early vote lead shrank for the fourth straight day, Arizona and Nevada tightened, and Texas opens early voting Monday morning. Here's where it stands and what you can do about it.

item.title: The gap closed again, but North Carolina needs to wake up
item.description: Almost a million more early ballots came in overnight and the Democratic lead in the hard counts shrank again. But North Carolina's first day of in-person voting should worry every Republican in the state.

item.title: Georgia showed up, Michigan is a coin flip, and the gap is closing
item.description: Georgia went from 5,538 early votes to almost 381,000 in one pull. Michigan's early vote gap is down to about half a point. Here's what the numbers actually say.

item.title: Why I built this site, and why you need to vote early
item.description: My research kept disappearing into 60-second videos, so now the receipts have a home. First up: early voting, because that's how we won in 2024.
